comments.quote: The hotel is nearby Yucun village, very convenient location . The owners are super nice and prepared a breakfast for us, so ot felt more like a home stay. They also have a lovely dog.
comments.author: Lana_adventures

comments.quote: Highly recommend. We stayed for the Spartan Race, and the owners went out of their way to make us feel comfortable. They even let us come back to the hotel way after our checkout time to shower again before driving...
